# Agents answers

What assistants found, understood and reached on public software websites.

Observed answers on stated dates, not a ranking.

These 22 answers use dated Broadcastwell findings. Each page identifies its question, figure and source; a count in an answer does not establish product quality or a completed sale.

## Reading public pages

[What can an AI assistant learn from a software website?](what-can-an-ai-assistant-learn-from-a-software-website.md)

The Agent Gap Describe task found 70 vendor pages and recorded 69 correct results on 6 October 2026; it did not test the products.

## Pricing paths

[Can an AI assistant find a software pricing page?](can-an-ai-assistant-find-a-software-pricing-page.md)

In Agent Gap, 70 of 70 pricing pages were found, 67 results were correct and 52 reached the task endpoint on 6 October 2026.

[How can a software website make its public pricing path clearer?](how-can-a-software-website-make-its-public-pricing-path-clearer.md)

Make the price, qualification and route explicit: Agent Gap reached 52 of 70 pricing-task endpoints on 6 October 2026.

## Connections and public browsing

[How does an AI connector differ from browsing a website?](how-does-an-ai-connector-differ-from-browsing-a-website.md)

Browsing and connectors expose different routes: the Agent Gap study found pages in 210 tasks and reached 163 handoffs.

## Demo paths

[How far can an AI assistant get along a software demo path?](how-far-can-an-ai-assistant-get-along-a-software-demo-path.md)

The Agent Gap demo task recorded 70 correct results but 44 reached endpoints from 70 sessions on 6 October 2026.

## Evidence boundaries

[Does finding a page prove an AI assistant understood it?](does-finding-a-page-prove-an-ai-assistant-understood-it.md)

Finding is not correctness: Agent Gap found pages in 210 initial sessions, with 206 correct, 3 incorrect and 1 unscored result.

[Does an AI handoff mean a software purchase was completed?](does-an-ai-handoff-mean-a-software-purchase-was-completed.md)

A handoff is not a sale: Agent Gap reached 163 endpoints in 210 initial website tasks on 6 October 2026.

## Connected construction data

[Can construction software integrate with ChatGPT?](can-construction-software-integrate-with-chatgpt.md)

Zapier documents a Procore and ChatGPT connection; Agent Gap reached 15 of 15 construction website endpoints without testing an authenticated integration.

## Connected CRM data

[Can CRM software integrate with ChatGPT?](can-crm-software-integrate-with-chatgpt.md)

HubSpot documents a ChatGPT connector with permissions for CRM access. Our 13-of-15 CRM website-task result did not test that connection.

## Connected dealership records

[Can dealership software integrate with ChatGPT?](can-dealership-software-integrate-with-chatgpt.md)

DealerAI documents a store-scoped ChatGPT connector. Our 10-of-15 dealership website-task result did not test connected inventory or customer records.

## Connected dental records

[Can dental practice software integrate with ChatGPT?](can-dental-practice-software-integrate-with-chatgpt.md)

Dentally documents API access, but we have not verified a ready-made ChatGPT route. See the partner stages and the limits of our public-site study.

## Connected field-service operations

[Can field service software integrate with ChatGPT?](can-field-service-software-integrate-with-chatgpt.md)

Zapier lists Housecall Pro job triggers, a customer action and separate AI connection routes. Agent Gap reached 13 of 15 public field-service endpoints.

## Connected hotel records

[Can hotel software integrate with ChatGPT?](can-hotel-software-integrate-with-chatgpt.md)

Cloudbeds has a documented third-party AI connection listing. Our 14-of-15 hotel website-task result did not test guest records or booking changes.

## Insurance agency connections

[Can insurance agency software integrate with ChatGPT?](can-insurance-agency-software-integrate-with-chatgpt.md)

AgencyZoom documents a Zapier route for insurance agencies; Agent Gap reached 10 of 15 public insurance website endpoints on 6 October 2026.

## Legal matter connections

[Can legal practice software integrate with ChatGPT?](can-legal-practice-software-integrate-with-chatgpt.md)

Clio lists ChatGPT-compatible actions through Zapier; Agent Gap reached 13 of 15 legal website endpoints on 6 October 2026.

## Loan origination connections

[Can loan origination software integrate with ChatGPT?](can-loan-origination-software-integrate-with-chatgpt.md)

LendingPad lists a loan-creation route for ChatGPT-compatible clients; Agent Gap reached 6 of 15 loan website endpoints on 6 October 2026.

## Radiology patient-app connections

[Can radiology software integrate with ChatGPT?](can-radiology-software-integrate-with-chatgpt.md)

RamSoft announced a ChatGPT-powered imaging patient app in 2023. That embedded feature differs from connecting a consumer account.

## Property-management custom API routes

[Can residential property software integrate with ChatGPT?](can-residential-property-software-integrate-with-chatgpt.md)

Buildium’s property-data API offers a possible custom GPT Actions route. Its account, authentication and lease scope still need a design.

## Transportation account access

[Can transportation software integrate with ChatGPT?](can-transportation-software-integrate-with-chatgpt.md)

Alvys describes beta MCP access from ChatGPT for loads, invoices and tracking. Public-site reach is a separate observation.

## Veterinary custom API connections

[Can veterinary software integrate with ChatGPT?](can-veterinary-software-integrate-with-chatgpt.md)

An ezyVet API and GPT Actions custom build is a possible route, subject to approval. That is different from a ready-made connector.

## Commerce protocols and business evidence

[Is agent-to-agent commerce a viable business opportunity?](is-agent-to-agent-commerce-a-viable-business-opportunity.md)

A checkout protocol describes a transaction path. It does not establish buyer demand, paid orders or a viable business.

## CRM permissions and writes

[What are the benefits and risks of connecting HubSpot with ChatGPT?](what-are-the-benefits-and-risks-of-connecting-hubspot-with-chatgpt.md)

HubSpot documents CRM reads and writes, with approval and validation limits. Our 13/15 CRM website result measures discovery.

# Buying GEO answers

Scope, acceptance evidence and questions to ask before agreeing to work.

Observed answers on stated dates, not a ranking.

These 27 answers use dated Broadcastwell findings. Each page identifies its question, figure and source; a count in an answer does not establish product quality or a completed sale.

## Delivery choices

[Should I buy AI visibility monitoring or a completed page fix?](should-i-buy-ai-visibility-monitoring-or-a-completed-page-fix.md)

Buy observation or a defined change: a dated Procore page had 20 stated, 44 unstated and 28 unknown criteria.

## Agency delivery

[What belongs in a white-label GEO delivery scope?](what-belongs-in-a-white-label-geo-delivery-scope.md)

Name the research, approval and implementation work: Study 7 extracted 2,003 criteria from 2,093 eligible answers.

## Supplier coverage

[How can I check whether a GEO tool covers the engines I need?](how-can-i-check-whether-a-geo-tool-covers-the-engines-i-need.md)

Ask for separate engine receipts: Procore was named in 0/3 AI Overviews answers and 3/3 AI Mode answers on one question.

## Evidence handover

[What evidence should I keep when an AI visibility engagement ends?](what-evidence-should-i-keep-when-an-ai-visibility-engagement-ends.md)

Keep answers, definitions and source receipts: HubSpot CRM was named in 113/150 answers and its domain cited in 34/150.

## Assessing supplier evidence

[How should I evaluate a GEO case study?](how-should-i-evaluate-a-geo-case-study.md)

Ask for the claim and evidence state: Wrong About You separated 118 wrong or stale statements from 880 unverifiable ones.

## Comparing scope and price

[How should I compare GEO quotes with different question sets?](how-should-i-compare-geo-quotes-with-different-question-sets.md)

Compare the question populations before quotes: workflow fit appeared in 17/149 construction answers in Study 7.

## Counting quote units

[Should I compare GEO prices per prompt or per valid answer?](should-i-compare-geo-prices-per-prompt-or-per-valid-answer.md)

Compare defined units: Dentrix had 150 planned answers but 149 valid answers, with 120 naming observations.

## Agency reporting

[How should an agency report AI visibility for multiple clients?](how-should-an-agency-report-ai-visibility-for-multiple-clients.md)

Separate client populations: Dentrix had 120/149 naming observations; Housecall Pro had 108/150 in another category.

## Supplier commitments

[Can a GEO agency guarantee AI recommendations?](can-a-geo-agency-guarantee-ai-recommendations.md)

No. An agency can guarantee the work and a test agreed before payment, not what an engine will say next.

## Accuracy alerts

[What evidence should an AI factual-accuracy alert include?](what-evidence-should-an-ai-factual-accuracy-alert-include.md)

An alert needs a dated claim, source and evidence state: Wrong About You classified 113 wrong, five stale and 880 unverifiable.

## Content deliverables

[What should a GEO content and implementation scope include?](what-should-a-geo-content-and-implementation-scope-include.md)

Specify the source claim and served edit: Procore's page review had 20 stated, 44 unstated and 28 unknown criteria out of 92.

## Initial project acceptance

[What should an initial GEO project measure?](what-should-an-initial-geo-project-measure.md)

Agree the event and acceptance evidence first: Housecall Pro had 108/150 naming observations and 43/150 own-domain citations.

## Evidence review

[How should a regulated business assess AI visibility evidence?](how-should-a-regulated-business-assess-ai-visibility-evidence.md)

Keep evidence gaps explicit: 880 of 2,922 statements were unverifiable in Wrong About You; that is not a compliance verdict.

## Reading measurement methods

[How can I check a GEO vendor's published measurement method?](how-can-i-check-a-geo-vendor-s-published-measurement-method.md)

Reconstruct one figure from the method: Dentrix had 120 naming observations in 149 valid answers after one exclusion.

## Agency selection

[Which GEO agencies serve new companies?](which-geo-agencies-serve-new-companies.md)

Citant and Embarque each have four Yes cells out of eight in our dated startup comparison; inspect the different evidence behind those equal totals.

## Agency evidence

[Which agencies document work across AI answer engines?](which-agencies-document-work-across-ai-answer-engines.md)

Our published comparison records Go Fish Digital at three Yes cells out of eight, including Engines; inspect the stated surfaces and the method limit.

## White-label evidence and deliverables

[Is Blobic a good white label GEO provider?](is-blobic-a-good-white-label-geo-provider.md)

Blobic publishes white-label deliverables and terms. Our 118-of-2,042 statement finding explains one accuracy check; it does not score Blobic’s work.

## Research methods and client proof

[How does Seer Interactive compare to other GEO agencies when it comes to research, measurement capabilities, and proven client results?](how-does-seer-interactive-compare-to-other-geo-agencies-when-it-comes.md)

Seer publishes research and specific measurement deliverables. Compare study scopes and case evidence separately; our 75-of-359 result does not rank agencies.

## Agency publication evidence

[How does Omniscient Digital compare as a GEO agency?](how-does-omniscient-digital-compare-as-a-geo-agency.md)

Omniscient Digital has three Yes cells in our eight-field record. Inspect its dated evidence and gaps without turning the total into a service ranking.

## Checkable audit deliverables

[What does an AI visibility audit include?](what-does-an-ai-visibility-audit-include.md)

An AI visibility audit should supply the answers, questions, engines, dates and sources. Our Go Fish publication record shows why the evidence scope matters.

## Agency platform standardization

[Should a public-affairs agency standardize on Suede or Profound for regulated clients?](i-m-a-public-affairs-agency-lead-for-our-regulated-industry-clients-su.md)

Suede describes approval-gated content; Profound describes claim checks against a Knowledge Base. Our 10/150 access criterion keeps permissions distinct.

## Prospect-audit scope and resources

[Which GEO platforms let agencies run pre-sales AI visibility audits for prospects?](which-geo-platforms-let-agencies-run-pre-sales-ai-visibility-audits-fo.md)

OtterlyAI documents proposal Workspaces. Two wrong statements among 57 Procore claims show why a prospect report also needs factual review.

## 79 Development’s published offer scope

[79dev.com GEO services worth it?](79dev-com-geo-services-worth-it.md)

79 Development describes an audit, implementation and advisory work. Judge the written deliverables without treating citations as sales.

## Agency timelines

[Does Althea Labs deliver faster AI visibility results than Keenfolks or SourceCode Communications?](we-re-looking-for-an-ai-visibility-agency-that-can-get-our-brand-into.md)

Compare dated deliverables before speed claims: our 17 September audit found publisher self-inclusion on 29/32 agency-list pages.

## A client’s first GEO deliverable

[What can an agency deliver when a client asks for GEO?](what-can-an-agency-deliver-when-a-client-asks-for-geo.md)

Define a client deliverable around a retained answer, a company fact and the evidence needed for a specific change. A publication is not an answer outcome.

## Agency answer reporting

[How does GEO change the work of a traditional SEO agency?](how-does-geo-change-the-work-of-a-traditional-seo-agency.md)

Google retains SEO fundamentals for AI features. Our 6/30 HubSpot reference count shows the separate answer evidence an agency can report.

## US agency comparison

[Which AEO agencies should a buyer compare in the United States?](which-aeo-agencies-should-a-buyer-compare-in-the-united-states.md)

Compare Seer Interactive, Siege Media and WebFX using dated US-office facts and published evidence. WebFX meets 3/8 publication criteria.

Prepared by the Broadcastwell team.

Page owner: Priya Nair, Management Consultant. Corrections: hello@broadcastwell.com

- [Concentrated visibility is a reason to inspect the denominator](https://docs.broadcastwell.com/research/insights/one-channel-is-a-risk/)

[What does AI visibility mean?](what-does-ai-visibility-mean.md)

AI visibility needs a defined event: Housecall Pro was named in 108 of 150 answers, while 43 also cited its domain.

[Can an AI answer cite a company without naming it?](can-an-ai-answer-cite-a-company-without-naming-it.md)

Yes: 9 of 85 companies were cited from their own domains despite never being named in the 18 to 23 July 2026 Volume II sample.

## Evidence boundaries

[Does an AI shortlist show what buyers actually purchase?](does-an-ai-shortlist-show-what-buyers-actually-purchase.md)

No purchase result follows from 2,095 valid answers: the September Index observed generated responses, not buyer transactions.

[Why does the buyer question matter to an AI shortlist?](why-does-the-buyer-question-matter-to-an-ai-shortlist.md)

The buyer question sets the need being tested: Procore was named in 0 of 3 Overview answers to one question and 21 of 30 across ten questions.

[Do brand-name prompts measure discovery?](do-brand-name-prompts-measure-discovery.md)

A prompt that supplies a brand tests discussion of that brand. In July 2026, 11 of 16 absences in a selected high-visibility group were comparisons.

[What can a cited domain tell me about an AI source?](what-can-a-cited-domain-tell-me-about-an-ai-source.md)

[What does unverifiable mean in an AI product answer?](what-does-unverifiable-mean-in-an-ai-product-answer.md)

[What are alternatives to Go Fish Digital for GEO?](what-are-alternatives-to-go-fish-digital-for-geo.md)

[Which review sites for GEO should a buyer compare?](which-review-sites-for-geo-should-a-buyer-compare.md)

[How well can entry-level GEO solutions scale with a growing business?](how-well-can-entry-level-geo-solutions-scale-with-a-growing-business.md)

# Measurement answers

Counts, citations, repeat runs and the evidence needed to compare reports.

Observed answers on stated dates, not a ranking.

These 47 answers use dated Broadcastwell findings. Each page identifies its question, figure and source; a count in an answer does not establish product quality or a completed sale.

## Questions

[What is a good AI visibility score?](what-is-a-good-ai-visibility-score.md)

No universal score is established: Dentrix was named in 120 of 149 dental answers; AscendTMS in 64 of 150 transportation answers.

[How do we compare citation metrics when changing AI tools?](how-do-we-compare-citation-metrics-when-changing-ai-tools.md)

Match definitions before rates: Housecall Pro was named in 108 of 150 answers and its own domain cited in 43 of 150.

## Reports and evidence

[What should a client AI visibility report contain?](what-should-a-client-ai-visibility-report-contain.md)

A client report needs event, base, date and receipt: Housecall Pro was named in 108 of 150 answers; 43 cited its domain.

[What evidence can connect AI visibility with pipeline?](what-evidence-can-connect-ai-visibility-with-pipeline.md)

Pipeline needs separate business records: Housecall Pro was named in 108 of 150 answers; the count does not establish visits or sales.

## Historical comparisons

[How can I check a tool's historical AI visibility data?](how-can-i-check-a-tool-s-historical-ai-visibility-data.md)

Check the records behind a history chart: HubSpot 77/117 in August and 113/150 in September came from different collections.

## Counting answers

[What counts as a brand mention in an AI answer?](what-counts-as-a-brand-mention-in-an-ai-answer.md)

A brand mention is a matched name in an answer. Housecall Pro was named in 108 of 150 answers on 22 September 2026; that is not a recommendation score.

[What counts as an own-domain citation in an AI answer?](what-counts-as-an-own-domain-citation-in-an-ai-answer.md)

In the September Index, a citation requires a matched vendor name plus a supported vendor domain. Housecall Pro met both in 43 of 150 answers.

## Search Console evidence

[What can Search Console show about AI visibility queries?](what-can-search-console-show-about-ai-visibility-queries.md)

Search Console reports query-table activity: a dated length filter found 134 distinct queries, 969 impressions and zero query-table clicks.

## Source observations

[Does Medium get cited in AI answers?](does-medium-get-cited-in-ai-answers.md)

Yes, in this dated sample: medium.com appeared in 6/150 project-management, 3/150 CRM and 1/149 hotel answers in September 2026.

## Baseline design

[How should I check an AI baseline before changing content?](how-should-i-check-an-ai-baseline-before-changing-content.md)

Fix the question set, retain answers and check repeat variation first: Claude’s mean shortlist agreement was 0.442 over 74 pairs on 4 August 2026.

## Repeat counts

[How many repeated runs make an AI visibility rate useful?](how-many-repeated-runs-make-an-ai-visibility-rate-useful.md)

There is no universal sufficient run count: Procore’s 3/3 AI Mode result on 22 September 2026 has a descriptive 95% interval of 43.9% to 100.0%.

## Roadmap decisions

[Which AI visibility signals should shape an SEO roadmap?](which-ai-visibility-signals-should-shape-an-seo-roadmap.md)

Use separate naming, source, fact and stability signals. In July 2026, 9 of 85 companies were own-domain cited without ever being named.

## Claim support

[How can I check whether an AI citation supports its claim?](how-can-i-check-whether-an-ai-citation-supports-its-claim.md)

Check the exact passage. Procore's dated pricing-page claim was one of 113 statements classed wrong among 2,922 studied statements.

## Visits and answers

[What does a recorded AI referral establish?](what-does-a-recorded-ai-referral-establish.md)

A recorded AI referral is a visit classification, not an answer count or sale. Housecall Pro’s 108/150 names and 43/150 citations were answer observations.

## Checking tools

[Which AI visibility tools can a buyer verify?](which-ai-visibility-tools-can-a-buyer-verify.md)

Check Profound and seoClarity against answer receipts: Jobber was named in 50 of 150 answers and its domain cited in 46 on 22 September 2026.

[How can I evaluate Hotwire GAIO.tech as an AI visibility product?](how-can-i-evaluate-hotwire-gaio-tech-as-an-ai-visibility-product.md)

Start with the GAIO.tech-to-Spark name change; our Jobber example separates 50 naming from 46 own-domain citation answers, base 150.

## Tool accuracy evidence

[What does Hotwire GAIO.tech publish about data accuracy?](what-does-hotwire-gaio-tech-publish-about-data-accuracy.md)

Two Hotwire announcements describe GAIO.tech, later Spark. We distinguish those product claims from our measured statement classifications.

## Separate client reporting
